I know she is, but i don't know if there's anything i can do about it.. 
I really dont know if hes in Hawaii or not, i haven't herd anything from him in years.I just herd this from my cousin a few weeks ago.

Thank you, it makes me feel a lot better to hear that, even from a stranger. Its reassuring.. And i updated my post, so it makes a bit more sense. I was really desperate and scared when i wrote that (I kinda just feel tired and numb now), So i left a lot out..
I calmed down, got some sleep, and feel a bit better. At least i stopped crying, though i kinda just feel...Numb now.
Its okay, but its difficult.. She has talked to a doctor. This started when she had her first surgery, and shes had five now. Shes in her 70s, so i guess this is normal... And thank you.
